package.description: Analyzes monitor resolutions and recommends RDP window positioning for optimal screen usage

en-US.description: Analyzes monitor resolutions and recommends RDP window positioning for optimal screen usage
en-US.longDescription: Detects the current monitor's resolution, DPI, and available display modes, then calculates optimal RDP window sizes and positions for single or dual-window layouts. Outputs ready-to-use winposstr values and can edit .rdp files directly.
en-US.name: Resolution Suggester
